general_information.name: UH, I THINK IT’S ETHAN PARK. THAT’S THE NAME ON MY DOCUMENTS, I’M PRETTY SURE—ETHAN, MIDDLE? NO, I DON’T KNOW A MIDDLE NAME, IF THERE IS ONE.

current_concerns.primary_problems: Uh, lately… it’s been a bit hard to put into words. I keep thinking about work stuff and meetings and then I lose my train of thought. Can you maybe ask that another way?
current_concerns.goals: I want to be able to speak up in a meeting without panicking, and maybe take the next promotion without backing away from it.

personal_history.early_childhood: I was born and raised in Toronto, and I was a pretty quiet, watchful kid… that’s the main thing I remember.
personal_history.adolescence_early_adulthood: School was okay, I was a good student, but I avoided presentations the whole time. I think that’s still kind of the pattern now, honestly.

personal_history.future_goals: I want to build a career that doesn’t depend on avoiding people.
